Named establishes the private immediate TypeArgument context; Group preserves it; Reference consumes it before descending, and Function, ForeignFunction, Tuple, Array and other constructors clear it. An immediate validation failure aborts the request rather than continuing with a partial frame. The inherited clone, own-formal text comparisons and headers retain their existing Budget calls.
